 Weather Forecast for Tomorrow, Thursday, November 12, 2026: BMKG Predicts Rain in Several Cities, Beware of Lightning
 The weather forecast for tomorrow, Thursday (11/12/2026), indicates that the potential for rain will persist in several regions of Indonesia. BMKG predicts varied conditions, ranging from cloudy to light rain and thunderstorms.
 By: Fadhila Nuraini 
 | 
 Editor: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Contributor: Adit Pranata 
 November 11, 2026, 21:01 WITA · 5 min read 
 Photo caption: Illustration of cloudy skies covering an urban area ahead of rain. BMKG predicts that several regions in Indonesia have the potential for rain and lightning on Thursday, November 12, 2026. (Illustration/Aktualita.co) 
 JAKARTA, Aktualita.co -  The weather forecast for tomorrow, Thursday (11/12/2026), indicates that the potential for rain will persist in several regions of Indonesia. The Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) predicts varied weather conditions, ranging from cloudy to light rain, and even rain accompanied by lightning in some areas. 
 Based on the BMKG forecast accessed on Wednesday (11/11/2026), several major cities such as Jakarta, Bandung, Semarang, Yogyakarta, Medan, and Makassar have the potential to experience rain with varying intensities. 
 Advertisement 
 People planning to travel, work outdoors, or commute between cities are advised to pay attention to weather changes, especially in areas with the potential for thunderstorms. 
 BMKG has also issued a weather outlook for the period of November 10–16, 2026, warning of an increased potential for rain in several regions of Indonesia due to atmospheric dynamics. 
 Jakarta Weather Forecast for Tomorrow, November 12, 2026 
 The DKI Jakarta region is expected to experience uneven weather conditions on Thursday. 
 Central Jakarta is forecast to be cloudy with temperatures ranging from 24–31 degrees Celsius. Similar conditions are expected in North Jakarta, with temperatures of 25–31 degrees Celsius. 
 Meanwhile, West Jakarta has the potential for light rain with temperatures of 24–32 degrees Celsius. 
 Special attention is needed for the residents of South Jakarta as BMKG forecasts the potential for thunderstorms. Temperatures in that area are expected to range from 24–32 degrees Celsius. 
 East Jakarta also has the potential for light rain with temperatures of 24–32 degrees Celsius. 
 These differences in weather conditions between regions are why the public needs to check forecasts based on their specific activity locations, rather than just the general Jakarta forecast. 
 Makassar Weather Tomorrow Has Potential for Light Rain 
 Moving to South Sulawesi, BMKG forecasts light rain in several districts of Makassar City on Thursday, November 12, 2026. 
 The Makassar District area is expected to experience light rain with temperatures around 26–30 degrees Celsius. Similar conditions have the potential to occur in Mamajang and Mariso. 
 In Mamajang, temperatures are forecast to range from 26–30 degrees Celsius, while Mariso is expected to be in the 26–29 degrees Celsius range. 
 This potential for rain should be noted by those traveling by motorcycle or public transport, especially when passing through areas with poor drainage systems. 
 Meanwhile, several areas in Pangkajene and Islands Regency are also forecast to experience different weather conditions. Liukang Tupabbiring has the potential for light rain, while Liukang Tangaya is forecast to be cloudy. 
 Weather Forecast for Bandung, Semarang, and Yogyakarta 
 In Bandung City, light rain is expected in several areas, including Sukasari, Coblong, and Babakan Ciparay. 
 Temperatures in Sukasari are forecast to be in the 19–28 degrees Celsius range, while the Coblong area will be around 18–28 degrees Celsius. 
 These conditions indicate that the air in Bandung may feel relatively cool, especially in the morning and at night. 
 Meanwhile, the forecast for Semarang City shows the potential for light rain in the districts of Central Semarang, North Semarang, and East Semarang. 
 Temperatures in Central Semarang are expected to range from 25–33 degrees Celsius. 
 In Yogyakarta, BMKG also forecasts light rain on Thursday. The Tegalrejo and Jetis areas are expected to experience temperatures around 24–30 degrees Celsius. 
 Residents in these urban areas still need to monitor weather developments because rain intensity can change in a relatively short time. 
 Surabaya, Medan, and Denpasar Tomorrow 
 Different conditions are expected in Surabaya. Several districts, including Karang Pilang and Wonocolo, are forecast to be cloudy on Thursday. 
 Temperatures in Karang Pilang are expected to range from 25–34 degrees Celsius, while Wonocolo will be around 25–33 degrees Celsius. 
 In Medan City, light rain is forecast for Medan Kota District with temperatures around 24–30 degrees Celsius. 
 The Medan Sunggal area even has the potential for moderate rain with temperatures in the 24–30 degrees Celsius range. 
 Meanwhile, Denpasar City is expected to experience varied weather. South Denpasar has the potential to be cloudy, while East, West, and North Denpasar are forecast to experience light rain. 
 BMKG Warns of Potential Heavy Rain and Strong Winds 
 In the weather outlook for November 10–16, 2026, published on November 10, BMKG explained that the increase in rain activity is influenced by several atmospheric factors. 
 One of these is the Madden-Julian Oscillation (MJO) activity, which is in phase 2 in the Indian Ocean, as well as the shift in seasonal wind patterns from the Australian Monsoon to the Asian Monsoon. 
 These conditions support the growth of rain clouds in several regions of Indonesia. 
 BMKG emphasized in its analysis: 
 The potential for moderate to heavy, and even locally very heavy rain, must continue to be watched. 
 For the period of November 10–12, 2026, BMKG has placed the Papua Highlands in the heavy rain alert category. 
 In addition, the Riau Islands and the Papua Highlands are among the regions that need to be wary of the potential for strong winds. 
 BMKG also identified the chance of increased moderate-intensity rain in several provinces, including West Java, Central Java, South Sulawesi, Central Sulawesi, West Kalimantan, and parts of Papua. 
 This warning is regional and does not mean that the entire territory within a province will experience heavy rain simultaneously. 
 Tips for Facing Tomorrow's Weather Changes 
 The public is advised to carry rain gear when engaging in outdoor activities and to avoid taking shelter under large trees during lightning or strong winds. 
 Drivers also need to maintain a safe distance and reduce speed when rain causes visibility to decrease. 
 In areas prone to flooding, residents should pay attention to the condition of water channels and avoid crossing roads with puddles of unknown depth. 
 In addition to the potential for rain, BMKG continues to remind the public about hot weather and dry air conditions in several regions. Body fluid intake needs to be monitored, especially for field workers. 
 The weather forecast for tomorrow, Thursday, November 12, 2026, may be updated following changes in atmospheric conditions. Therefore, the public is advised to check the latest information through official BMKG channels before traveling.
